# Validation

This document can be used to validate the inputs and result of the execution of the
upgrade transaction which you are signing.

> [!NOTE]
> Hashes below were generated against PLACEHOLDER `startingAnchorRootRoot` values
> (`0xdead...`). They MUST be regenerated (re-run the stacked simulation) once the
> honest super roots are filled in — and after the Unichain PAO transfer lands and the
> registry pin updates — before anyone signs.
